# Play — Carry the One

- SudokuPad: [Carry the One on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Carry the One on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed), including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
The sums are an invented rule, so no app enforces them. Each symbol is exported as a small cosmetic circle (red outline,
with "+" or "=" as its text) listed on the two cells it sits between. I expect the apps to centre it on their shared border, but I have not opened
the links in a browser to check. If a symbol looks misplaced, `grid.svg` in this folder is the reference picture: each marked row
has its symbols between columns 3|4 and 6|7, and each marked column between rows 3|4 and 6|7.

Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (constraints, givens, solution).
